2607.22722.title: A New Kind of Adversarial Example: Measuring the Human-Model Gap, and Its Relationship to OOD Detection
2607.22722.paper_summary: Almost all adversarial attacks add an imperceptible perturbation to fool a model. We instead study the opposite: a large, clearly visible perturbation that causes the model to keep its original, correct prediction, even though a human would no longer recognize the image. Prior work showed such examples can be generated at scale but left three questions untested: whether humans really perform worse than the model, whether standard out-of-distribution (OOD) detection and calibration tools catch it, and whether existing defenses mitigate it. We answer all three on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and ImageNet. (i) An independent recognizer proxy drops to ~49% on CIFAR-10 while the model stays at 100% -- a gap a small human pilot (N=5) corroborates directly and that is not explained by signal loss (a matched-magnitude Gaussian control degrades recognizability faster); a CLIP zero-shot proxy confirms the gap at ImageNet scale too. (ii) Confidence- and energy-based OOD detectors and calibration are structurally blind (0% detection, ECE ~= 0), while a feature-space Mahalanobis detector flags 100% -- but is evaded by an adaptive attacker at no cost to success. (iii) No classical defense, including adversarial training (45% robust accuracy), reduces attack success (correlation with large-epsilon_l resistance r ~= 0). A mechanistic analysis further shows the attack destroys low-level texture far faster than edge/shape structure.
2607.22722.paper_summary_zh: 幾乎所有的對抗攻擊都會添加一個不可察覺的擾動來欺騙模型。相反，我們研究的是相反的情況：一個大且明顯可見的擾動，使得模型保持其原始的正確預測，即使人類已經無法再識別該圖像。先前的工作顯示這樣的例子可以大規模生成，但留下了三個未經測試的問題：人類是否真的比模型表現更差，標準的分佈外（OOD）檢測和校準工具是否能捕捉到它，以及現有的防禦措施是否能緩解它。我們在MNIST、CIFAR-10和ImageNet上回答了這三個問題。(i) 一個獨立的識別器代理在CIFAR-10上的準確率降至約49%，而模型保持在100%——這一差距得到了小型人類測試者（N=5）的直接證實，且無法用信號損失解釋（匹配幅度的高斯控制使得可識別性下降得更快）；一個CLIP零-shot代理在ImageNet規模上也確認了這一差距。(ii) 基於信心和能量的OOD檢測器和校準在結構上是盲目的（檢測率0%，ECE約等於0），而一個特徵空間的Mahalanobis檢測器標記了100%——但被一個自適應攻擊者以零成本避開。(iii) 沒有任何傳統防禦措施，包括對抗訓練（45%的魯棒準確率），能減少攻擊成功率（與大ε_l抵抗的相關性r約等於0）。機械分析進一步顯示，該攻擊摧毀低層次的紋理速度遠快於邊緣/形狀結構。
2607.22722.author: Ali Borji et.al.
